_instructions: Source of truth for the build. DO NOT delete, edit, or renumber existing ids/titles. Statuses: passing (done+proven), failing (actionable), deferred (postponed; notes say when actionable), superseded (dead, kept for history). Flip failing->passing only when a test or the stated manual check proves it. Append new features with the next id in their milestone. Work ONE feature per session: lowest milestone, then lowest id, among 'failing'.

features.title: Run board rows show feature context: verify, depends_on, paths, effort/model, the feature's plan section (40 lines) and links to its plan and brief; rows show a ▸/▾ marker and pointer cursor
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with scripts/test-board.sh proving the expanded row shows verify/depends_on/paths, the plan section (cut at 40 lines, completed-plan fallback), file:// links to the plan and to existing briefs it names, escaped HTML, the row marker, and 60 features with plan sections under 1.0 s locally / 3.0 s with CI=1; bash scripts/ci-local.sh prints CI-LOCAL GREEN
